messages.subject: Re: bootstrap p_value

I'm not convinced this is a ggplot2 question. Looks more like it should go to manipulatR to me, but I'll bite. 

Can you provide an example dataset using dput() format or make one up? 

I know that there is pretty good model output formatting for lm() from the broom package that @drob made. 
https://github.com/dgrtwo/broom
With broom's functions you should be able to pull all of this information out of the lm() object. 

B
